title: Complete course coverage sources
details: The Course arch remains the formal qualification view using official units and assessment criteria
Evia evidence, RPL, Milos assessor observations and Tinos witness testimony now all count towards course and unit coverage progress
Opening a unit shows every official AC with its full wording
Each covered AC now shows coloured source ticks: yellow Evia, purple RPL, blue Milos and orange Tinos
The simpler learner activity view remains available through Evia
summary: Evia v241 keeps the official Unit → AC course view and makes all accepted evidence sources contribute consistently to progress and AC status ticks.
changes: Milos observations count in course coverage
Tinos witness testimony counts in course coverage
Source ticks shown on official ACs
